properties: requires the exact eight-route policy with stable owners and source paths
requires at least 20 raw interaction samples per route
aggregates interaction latency with nearest-rank p95
compares acknowledgement maximum and interaction p95 against provisional route budgets
rejects main-thread scans, blocking I/O, unbounded or oversize work slices, missing incremental indexes, and zero index revisions
rejects blank or duplicate sample IDs and incomplete route capture
emits every raw sample, route summary, budget, diagnostic, and qualification state in versioned JSON
successful command registration incrementally updates stable ID and normalized 1-3-gram posting indexes
non-empty queries intersect sorted posting lists before applying the existing field-aware ranking rules
duplicate registration does not mutate the index or advance its revision
recent-action lookup uses the stable ID index instead of rescanning command descriptors
index revision and last-query candidate count are observable for trace capture
a 256-command fixture narrows an exact route-token query to one scored candidate
beginSearch returns a resumable job whose default advance processes at most the governed 64 candidates
bounded advances retain only the requested top-ranked results and preserve a stable recency snapshot
the compatibility search API drives the same job to completion and produces identical ranking

interpretation.completed: PCQ-701 now has a file-backed policy, a native raw-sample-to-versioned-report path, incremental command-search candidate indexing, and a resumable model-layer search job with the governed 64-candidate default slice.
interpretation.notClaimed: The command palette does not yet have a production native UI caller that advances the job across frames. Passing deterministic samples prove the model and trace contracts; they are not measurements of shipping editor routes or approved performance baselines.
interpretation.remaining: Wire bounded search-job advancement into the native UI route, migrate the other declared routes to bounded asynchronous work, adopt the asset-browse/project-graph indexes, instrument real acknowledgements and completions for all eight routes, capture at least 20 samples per route on each target hardware class, approve budgets, emit measured reports, and obtain release signoff.
